Northwind Climate raises EUR 4 million seed round

Stockholm-based Northwind Climate has raised a EUR 4 million seed round led by Nordic Seed Partners, with participation from Aurora Angels.

The company, founded in 2023, builds carbon accounting software for mid-sized manufacturers.

Northwind Climate will use the funding to expand to Norway and Finland, chief executive Elin Strand said.

The Nordic climate technology market has grown quickly as manufacturers and property owners face stricter emissions reporting rules across the European Union.

More information is available on the company website.
